address: 20 Corick Road, Clogher, County Tyrone, Northern Ireland,BT76 0BZ
bio: Nestled in the serene countryside of County Tyrone, Corick House Hotel & Spa stands as a luxurious four-star retreat on a private estate. Surrounded by the picturesque rolling landscapes of the Clogher Valley, the hotel boasts enchanting Victorian walled gardens, adding to its charm.  Indulge in Afternoon Tea, available every day of the week, in the lavish ambiance of the conservatory, offering panoramic views of the exquisite walled gardens and the scenic Clogher Valleys and Mountains.  Afternoon Tea at Corick House Hotel & Spa promises an afternoon of refined elegance and style. Unwind in the serene Conservatory, surrounded by the beauty of our gardens, and savour an array of meticulously crafted afternoon delights. Delight in the Afternoon Tea experience, featuring a medley of freshly cut finger sandwiches, warm Corick House Scones paired with Devon Clotted Cream & Seasonal Preserve, homemade cakes, pastries, and a selection of the finest local herbal teas.
